items.body: Settling in and building friendships. Maths: Place Value unit. Reading: finding each child's level. Unit of Inquiry: Who We Are (culture, values, families, communities). Thanks to parents who contributed to the class Padlet.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 1 (This Week in Leeds)

items.body: English: biographies and autobiographies, key features and pair work. Maths: numbers in standard, word and expanded form, plus a Saudi Arabia shape project with number facts. Science: seedlings and how plants begin to grow. Drama: Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech and rights and responsibilities. A new student was named Student of the Week.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 2

items.body:
English, Drama and Unit of Inquiry: monologues and biographies, speaking and performance skills.
Maths: numbers in standard, word and expanded form, counting in powers of 10.
Science: pollination, seedlings and early plant growth.
Highlight: Saudi National Day celebration.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 3

items.body: Wrapping up the Who We Are unit: students studied five activists, presented freeze-frames and are writing and performing monologues. Maths: comparing numbers up to one million, negative numbers and a mental-arithmetic test. Science: seeds were planted and will be observed over the coming week. Highlight: the IB observation lesson went very well.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 4

items.body: Maths: Roman numerals and rounding numbers up to one million. Science: classroom plant observations finished and the plants went home to keep growing. The first Unit of Inquiry, Who We Are, closed with an assembly where students shared projects, freeze-frames and monologues. Photos and short videos of the assembly were attached to the email.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 5

items.body: English: the class began reading The Boy at the Back of the Class, linked to the new Unit of Inquiry, Where We Are in Place and Time (migration, belonging, friendship). Families are encouraged to get their child their own copy if possible. Science: the Earth's orbit and seasons. Maths: column addition, with column subtraction next week. Also covered: global trade in Global Citizenship, Britain's past and present in History, and friendship and inclusion in PSHE.
items.title: Year 5, end of week 6

items.body: The class teacher thanked students, parents and the school for another week of online learning and praised the children's progress over the past three weeks. This week students made their own bar graphs from the migration data the class collected and organised into a table. Parents are reminded to check the class Padlet and upload any work from this week. The teacher hopes for a return to offline learning soon.
